name: Ge Hang
current_role: Founder and largest shareholder of B-Soft Co., Ltd. (创业慧康, SZ:300451), Hangzhou; previously chairman
profile: Ge Hang founded Hangzhou B-Soft (创业软件, later 创业慧康), a developer of hospital and healthcare information systems listed in Shenzhen. In November 2025 he agreed to transfer about 6.23% of B-Soft and delegate voting rights to Hangzhou Genghao, an investment platform of HK-listed IVD Medical, which would give the company an actual controller.
interesting_fact: In Nov 2025 Ge Hang, as B-Soft's largest shareholder, signed a share-transfer and voting-delegation deal with Hangzhou Genghao (set up by IVD Medical) at RMB5.18/share, a deal framed by media as a bet on 'AI + healthcare'.
deep_cut_fact: Crunchbase lists him as a 1984 bachelor's graduate of Zhejiang University's electrical engineering school; B-Soft was built around hospital information systems.

name: Robin Faccenda
current_role: Chairman, Faccenda Group / owner of parent Hillesden Investments Ltd (per Wikipedia)
profile: Robin Faccenda (b. 1937) founded the poultry business that became Faccenda Foods in 1962, building it into the UK's second-largest chicken processor by 2008 via acquisitions such as Hinton Poultry, Perry Poultry and Webbs Country Foods. In 2018 Faccenda and Cargill combined their UK fresh poultry operations into the Avara Foods joint venture (6,000 staff).
interesting_fact: He was appointed OBE in the 2023 New Year Honours for services to the UK poultry industry and to education.
deep_cut_fact: He earned a National Diploma in Poultry from Harper Adams College in 1961 and later gave about £0.5m back to it; the Faccenda student centre opened in 2011 and Harper Adams made him a Fellow in 1992.
notes: Born 1937; no death notice found in brief search but alive status not positively confirmed (OBE Jan 2023 is latest dated item). No personal public channels found; route via Faccenda/Avara Foods corporate office. Not obviously relevant to energy/data-centre themes.

name: Hua Nan
current_role: Founder and Chairman, Dook Media Group (读客文化, SZ:301025), Shanghai
profile: Hua Nan co-founded the marketing-strategy firm Huayuhua (华与华) with his brother Hua Shan, which in 2006 invested to set up Dook Media, a book planning and distribution house. As chairman he built hits such as the Tibet Code (藏地密码) series; Dook listed on Shenzhen's ChiNext in 2021. He held about 41% directly as of Q3 2025; a planned control change was called off in Dec 2025.
interesting_fact: He has said his entry into publishing was 'very accidental'; after his first promoted title took off, the 2008 Tibet Code (藏地密码) series became a milestone, selling about 5.8 million copies by end-2020.
deep_cut_fact: Before Dook's IPO he was named China's Publisher of the Year (中国年度出版人) in 2009, credited with planning bestsellers including Tibet Code and The Godfather trilogy edition.
notes: Dook Media is listed (301025.SZ); IR/board-secretary contact is in its exchange filings (not verified here). Brother Hua Shan is the better-known public figure (Huayuhua).

name: Huang Jinxi
current_role: Honorary Chairman (名誉董事长), Guangdong Homso / Xiongsu Technology (雄塑科技, SZ:300599), from Oct 2025
profile: Huang Jinxi (b. June 1949) is a co-founder of Homso (雄塑科技), a Foshan, Guangdong maker of plastic/polymer pipes and building materials for construction and municipal use, listed in Shenzhen in 2017. He served as vice-chairman for years and in Oct 2025 became honorary chairman, with Huang Ganxiong as chairman.
interesting_fact: He chaired Shunde Xiongsu Industrial (顺德区雄塑实业) from 1996 to 2003, the forerunner of today's listed Homso pipe business founded in Foshan's Nanhai district.
deep_cut_fact: His official filing bio notes he is a graduate of Longjiang Middle School in Longjiang town (Shunde), with high-school education, and holds Macau permanent residency.
notes: Listed-company board data from Sina Finance (300599). Board secretary is Li Dan per Sina; company IR contact available in exchange filings. Low public profile.

name: Huang Junhui
current_role: Founder and former Chairman/GM of Great-Sun Foods (宏辉果蔬, SH:603336), Shantou; chairman until March 2023
profile: Huang Junhui (b. 1963) founded Shantou SEZ Honghui Foods in 1992, which became Great-Sun Foods (宏辉果蔬), a fruit and vegetable sourcing, processing and cold-chain business listed in Shanghai. He chaired it until March 2023; the board has since changed hands (new chairman Ye Tao from Sept 2025). He has held roles including Shantou chamber of commerce chairman and Guangdong CPPCC standing member.
interesting_fact: Before founding his food business he trained at Shantou University and worked as a doctor at Foshan Sanshui Leping central health clinic and Shantou Central Hospital.
deep_cut_fact: His filing bio lists him as vice-president of both the China Fruit Marketing Association and the China Vegetable Marketing Association, and honorary president of the Cambodia Teochew overseas fellowship association.
notes: Hurun 'Grate-sun Foods' = Great-Sun Foods / 宏辉果蔬 (603336), identified via company match and Sina Finance board records. Shared Hurun entry with Zheng Youwen (not researched here). Roles listed in bio may be dated.

name: Liu Guoyao
current_role: Chairman, Nanjing Sciyon Wisdom Technology Group (科远智慧, SZ:002380)
profile: Liu Guoyao (b. 1962), a former Southeast University power-engineering lecturer, co-founded Nanjing Sciyon (科远), an industrial automation and smart-plant technology company listed in Shenzhen in 2010, where he is chairman and a co-controlling shareholder (~61m shares). He was re-elected chairman in Sept 2025.
interesting_fact: He started as a teacher in Southeast University's power engineering department (thermal control) and head of the instrument lab at its vibration engineering institute; he later won a Jiangsu Science and Technology first prize (2017).
deep_cut_fact: He holds a master's in engineering from Southeast University and a Tsinghua SEM EMBA, is an honorary trustee of Southeast University and an off-campus PhD supervisor there, and in 2020 was named a 'caring ambassador' for Jiangning district's youth dream fund.
notes: Hurun 'Keyuan' = 科远 (Sciyon), Nanjing; identified via Lixinger controlling-holder listing and Sina Finance bio. Relevant to energy angle (thermal control/power-plant automation background). Board secretary: Zhao Wenqing (per Sina). Company site sciyon.com could not be fetched.
